text.headline: Zong-Liang Yang: A Climate Science Journey
text.text: From Australia to Texas, tracing the geographic arc of a pioneering climate scientist.

text.headline: Melbourne: Graduate Studies
text.text: M.S. in Meteorology from University of Melbourne.

text.headline: Sydney: Doctoral Research
text.text: Ph.D. in Atmospheric Sciences from Macquarie University (1989-1992).

text.headline: Arizona: Postdoctoral Work
text.text: Postdoc and research faculty at University of Arizona.

text.headline: Austin: Faculty Career
text.text: Professor at UT Austin since 2001, Jackson Chair, AGU Fellow.
